text:
Amy (CEO): Quick heads-up: Friday 9am PT all-hands, 40 minutes. Format: 25m updates, 15m live Q&A. We want crisp, actionable updates. Drop any Qs here or use the form: https://forms.redwood.com/ah-quick.

Ravi - Product: Draft agenda: 1) product metrics (latency/cost), 2) Dedicated rollout status, 3) customer highlight (Nimbus), 4) SDK/CLI notes. I'll post slides Wed noon.

Tina - Eng: I'll take 60s to summarize the recent routing incident and the mitigation steps (cache warmup + fallback tuning).

Mark - DevEx: Can we have 3 minutes for SDK migration guidance? I want to show a tiny code diff and link to the migration guide.

Amy (CEO): Yes. Keep it focused. If you need more than the allocated time, flag now so we can adjust.

Sofia - People Ops: People Ops will add a 90s hiring & org update after product. Nothing heavy, just top-line numbers and a link to open roles.

Ravi - Product: Slide link: https://drive.redwood.com/ah/3160000000/draft-slides — please comment by Thu EOD.

Tina - Eng: Q for leadership: any SLA changes planned for next quarter?

Amy (CEO): No SLA changes planned next quarter. Our focus is meeting current targets and rolling out Dedicated smoothly. We'll give 30 days' notice for any SLA edits.

Mark - DevEx: I'll prepare the migration snippet and changelog entry; will post to the drive after the meeting.

all-hands-bot: Reminder set for Fri 9:00am PT. Recording & transcript will be posted here.

(After meeting) all-hands-bot: Recording: https://zoom.redwood.com/recordings/3160000000-sprint-brief 024-02-15. Transcript in drive.

Ravi - Product: Post-meeting notes: Dedicated rollout is now in the final validation stage; expect phased GA next month. Latency: p95 improved 6%, p99 steady. Customer Nimbus saved ~18% on per-token costs with batching. Slides + notes: https://drive.redwood.com/ah/3160000000/notes.

Tina - Eng: Follow-up: routing fallback adjustments deployed to canary. I'll open the rollout ticket for full cluster, cc @Mark - DevEx.

Mark - DevEx: Posted SDK migration snippet and a brief migration checklist: https://docs.redwood.com/sdk-migration. Also updated changelog.

Amy (CEO): Key takeaways: keep SLA steady, finalize Dedicated GA plan, and make migration guidance extremely clear for customers. Thanks everyone for the prep.

Sofia - People Ops: Action: People Ops will share hiring one-pager by EOD Monday.

Amy (CEO): Closing 10: appreciate the quick updates — see follow-ups in the drive. :clap:
